notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
Small update 25-03
- The electrical towers now inflict more damage with continuous use
- The game now pauses and stops all music and sounds when out of focus (using Alt+Tab). 
- Improved Blood bar feedback: the entire bar, including the blood counter, will now light up when blood is collected
